reference.name: Best possible plan (central MILP, perfect information)

headline.text: Q-Grid lands 2.3% from the best possible plan; the closest alternative without a central controller, Particle swarm optimisation, lands 23.5% (paired Wilcoxon p < 0.001).
headline.detail: Among methods that work without a central controller, Q-Grid is closest to the best possible plan on 3 of 5 campuses; elsewhere (BDG2 university site 'Bull' (Texas); BDG2 university site 'Cockatoo' (New York)) another method is closer.
